crime: For several weeks, {WITCH_NAME} and another girl silently exchanged ordinary library books during afternoon free time. {WITCH_NAME} understood each book the girl returned as an answer to the one she had chosen.

One afternoon, a third reader returned a book to the girl. The girl immediately understood why it had been chosen. The girl then told {WITCH_NAME} that none of her choices had ever made sense; the girl had assumed {WITCH_NAME} was passing along unrelated books she had finished. The girl offered to explain each future choice.
One book {WITCH_NAME} had left for the girl was still in the girl's cell. During the same free-time period, the girl went to fetch it. The witch followed, and the barred door remained open.

Later, the prisoners found the girl slumped at the base of the far stone wall. The back bore bruises from the wall, and the ribs, sternum, and spine had been crushed. At first, the injuries suggested that an attacker or a heavy object removed afterward had pinned the girl against the stone.

But the prisoners found two straight, unbroken heel streaks running from the middle of the cell to the wall. They showed that the girl had remained upright while a sustained force drove the body backward. The wall had marked only the back; the front of the torso had no contact mark, and no heavy object remained in the cell. A torn strip of {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive prison clothes was clenched in the girl's hand. It matched a fresh tear in the witch's sleeve.

The girl had caught {WITCH_NAME}'s sleeve before being pushed away. From beside the open doorway, the witch kept using Repulsion to drive the girl straight back. Even after the wall stopped the girl, the witch continued pushing until the pressure crushed the torso and spine.
fields.epitaph: The distance she guarded left no room for her in the end.
execution: Two tall iron plates stand face to face, with her restrained upright between them, one before her and one behind.

They advance together, closing the gaps before and behind her. The plates strike her chest and back and keep closing. Her ribs and sternum collapse, and her spine breaks. The plates stop with her flattened corpse held between them.

magic.name: Repulsion
magic.text: She can push people away from her.
